secured: The app never spelled it out, but from the screen it seems a day counts as secured once you finish your task for that day. Right now it says '0 days secured' and 'Nothing done today. 1 task left.'
freeze: The app never explained what a freeze is in anything I saw, so I can't say. I'd only be guessing that it saves a streak.
selfReported: It seems to mean you just check the task off yourself, with no photo or other proof. 'Do 10 pushups' says Self-reported with a 'Check off' button, while the water challenge asked for a camera proof.
